atoms.text: Rose is keeping track of how many hours a day she practises the piano. This time graph shows how many hours she practised each day for 4 days.

instruction.text: Fill out the table using the graph.

instruction.text: Maggie harvested her blueberries every day for a week and recorded her harvest. This graph shows how many blueberries she harvested each day. Look at the time graph and answer the questions.

atoms.a: How many blueberries did Maggie harvest on day 7?
How many blueberries did she harvest on day 2?
How many blueberries did she harvest on the most productive day?
atoms.hint: The most productive day is the day on which she harvested the most blueberries.

atoms.a: How many blueberries did she harvest on day 1?
On how many days did she harvest exactly 300 blueberries?
How many more blueberries did she harvest on day 4 than day 1?
atoms.hint: Subtract the number of blueberries harvested on day 1 from the number harvested on day 4.
